Greenskeeper's stroke-index rows ARE clean (men's and women's each a complete 1-18 permutation, odds front / evens back) but the schema requires par alongside stroke index, so they are omitted too. TOTALS confidence is high: GolfPass and golfscorekeeper agree exactly on 6840/6288/5651, and GolfPass's 4602 Red total is corroborated by a GolfNow-sourced description ('as short as 4,602 yards'). It reveals SIX tees (Black, Blue, White, Gold, Red, Silver); greenskeeper lists only four.

ARITHMETIC: five of six tees verified EXACTLY against the card's own printed Out/In/Total. Black 3565+3503=7068, Blue 3312+3293=6605, White 3080+3060=6140, Red 2745+2654=5399, Silver 1423+1272=2695.

GOLD TEE - THE CARD ITSELF IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT. Gold front nine sums to 2798, matching the printed Out of 2798. Gold back nine sums to 2745, but the card prints In = 2695 - a 50-yard gap. The printed Out + printed In (2798+2695) equals the printed Total of 5493, so the card is self-consistent in its summary row and the error is in a hole cell. The anomaly is hole 12: the card prints White 394, Gold 387, Red 327, which puts Gold above where it should sit and is exactly 50 more than the 337 that would reconcile the column. I re-cropped and magnified that cell to confirm the glyph reads 387, and I have KEPT 387 as printed rather than silently correcting it to 337. published_total is recorded as the card's printed 5493. Flagging for human review against a physical card: one of Gold hole 12 (387) or Gold In (2695) is a printing error.

STROKE INDEX - THIRD-PARTY DATA WAS WRONG, OFFICIAL CARD USED: GolfPass's men's back-nine handicap row (9,14,6,4,18,12,2,10,16) is shifted one position relative to the official card (14,6,4,18,12,2,10,16,8) and duplicates 9 while omitting 8. Had I trusted it, or 'repaired' it by the obvious-looking inference that hole 10 should be 8, I would have written eight wrong values. The official card's rows are used verbatim; both verified to contain each of 1-18 exactly once. GolfPass's women's row happens to match the card and is noted as corroboration.

PAR: the card prints ONE undifferentiated Par column but TWO separate handicap columns ('M Hcp' and 'W Hcp'). Because the handicap rows are gender-separated, men's and women's entries are both provided, each carrying the same single printed par array. Front 36 + back 36 = 72.

RATINGS: taken from the card's Rating/Slope footer rows. Black 73.7/128 and Blue 71.6/124 are printed without a gender letter (men's). White, Gold and Red are printed with explicit M and W lines, so each carries two rating entries over one set of yardages. The Silver tee has BLANK rating and slope cells on the card, so no ratings were recorded for it - none were invented. Greenskeeper's and GolfPass's differing rating figures are superseded by the official card.

ADDRESS/WEBSITE: the card's reverse (page 2, course rules) prints '2501 Country Club Rd., Cleburne, TX 76033 | (817) 641-4501 | www.cleburnelinks.com', confirming the assigned address and giving the course's own domain (the assigned URL https://www.cleburne.net/1505/Golf-Course is the city's page for it).

NINE IDENTIFICATION - the only published per-hole grid is an 18-hole card covering South (front) + West (back). ARITHMETIC SELF-CHECK - South sum + West sum vs published South/West 18-hole total: Black 3446+3413 = 6859 (matches 6859). Blue 3241+3168 = 6409 (matches Greenskeeper's 6409; GolfPass says 6429, a 20-yd conflict between sources - Greenskeeper's grid is self-consistent so its value was kept). White 3047+2996 = 6043 (matches). Gold 2806+2730 = 5536 (matches). RED FAILS: 2495+2519 = 5014 against a published 5068, a 54-yard shortfall. Per the internal-inconsistency rule the printed values were kept unchanged. Diagnosis for the human reviewer: the deficit is exactly 54 and South hole 1 Red is printed as 217; 271 would reconcile the total precisely (271-217 = 54), so a digit transposition at South hole 1 Red is the most likely explanation. The page was re-read twice with different prompts and does print 217 both times, so nothing was altered. Verify South hole 1 Red against the club scorecard JPG before trusting the Red row.

NORTH NINE - NO DATA ENTERED, deliberately. No per-hole yardages, pars or stroke indexes for the North nine are published in machine-readable form anywhere located (Greenskeeper, 18Birdies, the club site, GolfPass, AllGolfHoles, GolfScoreKeeper all lack it; BlueGolf returns 405, GolfTraxx 403, and the club's own data is inside the 27-hole scorecard JPG). Its 'tees' array is intentionally empty rather than derived. FOR REFERENCE ONLY, not entered as data: subtracting the West/South nine totals from the 18-hole combo totals gives North Black = 6924-3446 = 3478 and 6891-3413 = 3478, which agree; but the other tees do NOT reconcile across combos (White implies 3056 from North/South yet 2991 from West/North, a 65-yd conflict; Red implies 2339 vs a value 65 yds off the same way; Gold is off by 1 yd), so no North totals were recorded. Note also that BlueGolf lists both a 'North/South' (6,924) and a separate 'South/North' (6,876) entry, and a West/North of 6,843 against GolfPass's 6,891 - the facility clearly has multiple rating vintages in circulation.

STROKE INDEX - OMITTED for both nines because two published allocations conflict on the ordering itself. Greenskeeper prints an 18-hole allocation: men South 11,1,9,17,13,7,15,5,3 and West 14,16,4,2,18,12,10,8,6; women South 11,1,7,17,5,13,15,3,9 and West 16,18,8,4,14,10,12,2,6 (each set is a valid 1-18 partition). 18Birdies prints per-nine 1-9 rows: South 8,3,7,9,5,2,4,6,1 and West 7,8,3,2,9,1,4,5,6. RATINGS - NONE attached to the nine-hole courses, because every rating this facility publishes is for an 18-hole pairing, never for a single nine. The full published combo ratings are captured in the source notes above.
